items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: If you hadn't been tied up with Graham, you would have made that $5,000 right off on it.

ctx.x: I get this from Edward H. Morris, Melrose Music Corporation, see?
Oh yeah, that's...so they own it now. Let's see, this...Graham must have sold out. Yeah. Must have sold out his rights.
Yeah, he did. They bought his own library.
